_about: The Anomalous Force Protein (weight_booster, 339) in a pocket knocks its carrier's gun-stock kills' ragdolls 16 times as hard (the owner, 2026-11-05): a built-in modification 1330 of player modifier 29 (stamina_boost_interval, which no 0.26g code reads) +15, which the ragdoll patch (visual only) reads from the killer's kit, docs/notes/force-protein-knockback.md. Its card line is property 175 (Melee knockback: +1500%, a percentage like 105). The booster gets the key its modification changes, as every booster has those of its own. boosters.tsv makes 1330 the booster's built-in (column knockback), modifications.tsv holds its row.
